newsitem.title: USA: Florida approves two Board of Regents bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Florida approves two Board of Regents bond issues.

text.p: Florida Board of Administration approved two Board of Regents revenue bond issues, the state Division of Bond Finance said Wednesday.
A $40.395 million University System Improvement issue, Series 1997, will finance improvements approved by the Legislature and will be repaid with capital improvement fees and student building fees.
The other is a $9.78 million University of Central Florida Parking Facility issue, Series 1997, to bulding a parking garage at the school in Orlando. Debt service is to be paid with parking revenues.
